title: Add residency-attestor orchestrator and operator-lease RBAC with KMS origin locker
author: Maya Chen
description: Context: Several regulated customers require that operator actions touching tenant data are constrained by both (a) verifiable KMS key provenance (region pin) and (b) timebound operator leases so that cross-region operator privileges are transient. This PR ships a production-ready residency-attestor orchestrator and an operator-lease RBAC enforcer plus KMS origin locker middleware. What this changes: 1) new residency-attestor service (pkg/residency/attestor) that accepts signed residency assertions, validates KMS key provenance via the KMS Provenance API, and emits deterministic residency verdicts with a provenance token; 2) operator-lease RBAC enforcer (pkg/rbac/lease_enforcer) that mints and validates short-lived lease tokens for operator roles and integrates with the RBAC v2 decision path; 3) KMS origin locker middleware (infra/kms/origin_locker) which prevents requests using keys from disallowed geozones unless an explicit lease is present; 4) console UX hook to request operator leases (console/ui/operator_lease_request.jsx) and a feature flag for staged rollout; 5) integration tests and an audit forwarder shim to tag audit events with residency provenance. Motivation: reduce blast radius for cross-region operator activity and provide cryptographic proof that a request used an allowed KMS key for tenant data in the asserted region. Rollout plan: feature-flagged on staging, small canary on dedicated capacity, metrics verification and a 48h quick rollback window. Testing: unit tests for attestor validation logic, simulated KMS provenance mock in integration tests, e2e smoke that verifies audit envelope contains provenance token. Backwards compatibility: default behavior remains permissive until the feature flag is turned on for a tenant; no breaking API changes to client-facing endpoints. Follow-ups: telemetry retention tuning (SEC-220) and documentation for operator playbooks. Checklist: [x] design doc linked (Linear ENG-4481), [x] unit+integration tests added, [x] console + API hooks wired, [x] canary rollout plan documented, [ ] post-rollout telemetry tuning (SEC-220).

review_comments: Liam O'Connor: Can you clarify the lifetime of the lease token and the revocation path? The implementation notes 2h default but I want explicit revocation support for emergency rollbacks.
Maya Chen (author): Lease defaults to 2 hours; added an emergency-revoke endpoint backed by the operator-lease cache and a broadcast to control-plane watchers (see pkg/rbac/lease_enforcer/revoke.go).
Priya Patel: We need to ensure audit entries include the KMS provenance token and sticky tenant id so SRE can correlate—tests look good but add an explicit field in the audit schema.
Maya Chen (author): Updated audit forwarder shim to include provenance_token and residency_evidence fields; added integration test asserting both fields are present.

Maya Chen (author): Switched integration tests to use kms-testkit and added negative tests for mismatched regions.
release_notes: Adds a residency-attestor orchestrator service for validating KMS key provenance, an operator-lease RBAC enforcer for timebound operator privileges, and a KMS origin locker middleware. Feature is behind a feature flag; rollout plan documented in ENG-4481. Impact: improves compliance controls for geo-residency and reduces operator blast radius.
notes: GA target deferred to next patch cycle pending telemetry tuning; staged canary completed on dedicated-2 with 1% traffic for 24h and no incidents.
